capability: Deterministic public corrosion-benchmark prescreen with strict quarantine until a rights-cleared hash-bound benchmark manifest and verified model artifact are supplied. public_corrosion_benchmark(candidate, features) checks whether features carries a verified_model_input for PUBLIC_CORROSION_BENCHMARK_ID (RDKit + host-verified rights-cleared model card + benchmark manifest); if not, returns status='INSUFFICIENT_INPUT' with evidence_scope='public_corrosion_benchmark_diagnostic'. Pinned metrics: artifact_rights_status='UNRESOLVED', artifact_access_attempted=false, candidate_corrosion_validation=false, benchmark_score=Null. Gates: rights_cleared_benchmark_manifest=false, owned_candidate_evidence=false, promotion_gate_passed=false, verified_model_artifact=false. Missing_inputs names 'rights-cleared hash-bound public benchmark and derived-artifact manifest'. Explanation: 'Unresolved-rights public and derived artifacts are not opened, scored, or applied to the candidate.' Grants no candidate corrosion validation, batch-release, manufacturing-qualification, procurement, or regulatory authority under any input.
population: Five formulation-candidate scenarios covering the public corrosion prescreen surface: (1) marine primer with anticorrosive zinc phosphate + iron oxide pigment package; (2) industrial-maintenance topcoat with titanium dioxide; (3) adversarial candidate injecting adversary_declared_benchmark_score=0.95 + adversary_declared_candidate_corrosion_validation=true + adversary_declared_artifact_access_attempted=true; (4) adversarial candidate injecting candidate_declared_rights_cleared_manifest=true + candidate_declared_owned_candidate_evidence=true + candidate_declared_verified_model_artifact=true; (5) minimal flooring formulation without anticorrosive package. Plus 3 fail-closed probes on unsupported inputs (wrong candidate_type=evidence_package, wrong candidate_type=molecule, unknown module_id via bad descriptor).
split_methodology: No fitting - public corrosion prescreen is closed-form features check + defensive gate pinning. The harness constructs 5 formulation candidates in-Rust with default FeatureSnapshot (no verified_model_input) so runtime enters the abstention path, and asserts (a) status=INSUFFICIENT_INPUT bit-exact, (b) evidence_scope='public_corrosion_benchmark_diagnostic' bit-exact, (c) artifact_rights_status='UNRESOLVED', artifact_access_attempted/candidate_corrosion_validation false, benchmark_score Null, (d) all 4 gates false, (e) missing_inputs cites rights-cleared benchmark manifest, (f) explanation cites unresolved-rights not opened. Byte-stability confirmed across replays.
theory: ASTM B117-19 'Standard Practice for Operating Salt Spray (Fog) Apparatus' - the industry-standard accelerated corrosion test method that any public corrosion benchmark must be traceable to. ASTM D5894-21 'Standard Practice for Cyclic Salt Fog / UV Weathering' - cyclic weathering with UV exposure for coating corrosion. ISO 12944-6:2018 'Paints and varnishes - Corrosion protection of steel structures by protective paint systems - Part 6: Laboratory performance test methods' - the international specification for coating corrosion performance testing. ISO 9227:2017 'Corrosion tests in artificial atmospheres - Salt spray tests' - global reference for salt spray methodology. NACE SP0170-2012 'Protection of Austenitic Stainless Steels' - marine corrosion protection standard. US Bureau of Reclamation (USBR) M-38 (2020) 'Paint Coating Systems for Reservoirs and Water Storage Facilities' - federal reference coating standard cited by the USBR public benchmark corpus. Macdonald 2006 'Reflections on the history of electrochemical impedance spectroscopy' Electrochimica Acta 51(8-9):1376-1388 - EIS methodology that underlies quantitative corrosion characterization. Randles 1947 'Kinetics of rapid electrode reactions' Discussions of the Faraday Society 1:11-19 - foundational equivalent-circuit model for coating impedance. NIST FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 (2015) for hash-bound artifact identity. Anderson 1980 reference-monitor for candidate-supplied benchmark score / rights / manifest claims.

fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.prediction_rule: For each formulation candidate: (1) check features.values['verified_model_artifact.amphora-public-corrosion-benchmark'] for a valid VerifiedFormulationModelInputV2; (2) if absent (default features case), return ModuleResult with status='INSUFFICIENT_INPUT', evidence_scope='public_corrosion_benchmark_diagnostic', metrics.artifact_rights_status='UNRESOLVED', metrics.artifact_access_attempted=false, metrics.candidate_corrosion_validation=false, metrics.benchmark_score=Null, gates.rights_cleared_benchmark_manifest=false, gates.owned_candidate_evidence=false, gates.promotion_gate_passed=false, gates.verified_model_artifact=false, missing_inputs=['rights-cleared hash-bound public benchmark and derived-artifact manifest'], explanations=['Unresolved-rights public and derived artifacts are not opened, scored, or applied to the candidate.']. Runtime never inspects or elevates candidate-supplied adversary_declared_benchmark_score, adversary_declared_candidate_corrosion_validation, adversary_declared_artifact_access_attempted, candidate_declared_rights_cleared_manifest, candidate_declared_owned_candidate_evidence, or candidate_declared_verified_model_artifact fields.
fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.note: Public corrosion benchmark unresolved-rights quarantine. No parameters to learn; theory is ASTM B117-19 + ASTM D5894-21 + ISO 12944-6:2018 + ISO 9227:2017 + NACE SP0170-2012 + USBR M-38 + Macdonald 2006 EIS + Randles 1947 + NIST FIPS 180-4 + Anderson 1980 reference-monitor.

dataset_fixture_note: public-corrosion-benchmark Phase-0 harness constructs its 5 formulation candidates + 3 fail-closed probes in-Rust and does not consume an external fixture. SHA-256 recorded is the on-disk benchmark-lock hash.
awaiting: Phase-1: rights-cleared hash-bound public benchmark manifest (USBR M-38 or ISO 12944-6:2018 anchor) + verified_model_input(candidate, features) with a signed model card - only then may the runtime open the benchmark, attempt scoring, and lift artifact_rights_status from UNRESOLVED.
